verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is a managed sandbox platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP mention ("remote MCP controls over HTTP or HTTPS") describes protocol controls on sandbox network traffic, an adjacent feature rather than a first-party MCP server agents can connect to. The SDK integrations, CLI, and llms.txt are not MCP servers either, so there is no evidence of the capability.
